name: Rough Ridge Campground
note: Small primitive campground on the south side of Tellico River Rd (FR 210), about 17 miles above the ranger station and 300 m downstream of State Line; a handful of large pull-in sites, each with two picnic tables, two lantern posts and a grill/fire ring. The Forest Service calls it a group campground, but its sites are sold one at a time. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/rough-ridge-campground (read 2026-11-25, 'Site Open', page updated 2025-03-20): its own FS page, separate from State Line 4416 - 'One of two group campgrounds located adjacent to Tellico River, each site in Rough Ridge Campground contains two picnic tables, two lantern posts, and a grill/firering. These sites can accommodate two 26 foot camping trailers and four cars.', 'Single Site: $10 per night / Double Site: $20 per night', 'Open year-round', vault toilet, no potable water; rec.gov facility 10158837 active (is_deactivated false), 'first-come, first-served basis only', Scan & Pay. 26-ft trailer capacity per site passes the 23-ft fit. 'Group campground' is the FS's word for the double-size sites, not group-only booking: single sites are sold at $10 for 5 people or fewer, exactly as at State Line 4416 (same wording, kept in phase 7 p3-613). FS alerts (read 2026-11-25) carry no Tellico River Rd / FR 210 closure (only Citico Creek and other districts). Public, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-25: Esri World_Imagery at 35.2609,-84.0842 (hw 90 m, leaf-off, rendered) and 35.2610,-84.0832 (hw 90 m, rendered) shows FR 210 curving across the north of the frame, and south of it a gravel pull-off with two picnic tables (~35.2611,-84.0841) and two or three angled pull-in spurs (~35.2609,-84.0838); the upper Tellico River is a narrow whitewater channel (well under 30 m wide - creekside at most) under open woods to the W/SW. No road lies between the sites and the stream, but a wooded band does. 3DEP (epqs.nationalmap.gov) transects: the pull-off/table flat sits at 780.9-781.2 m to ~20 m out, then drops ~3 m within about 5 m (781 -> 778) to the channel floor (777.7-778.0 m) 25-40 m from the pull-off; from the tables the channel is 35-45 m off, from the spurs 40-50 m, with the same steep last drop. A ~3 m steep bank through woods is not an easy walk down, and the spurs are near the 50 m bound. Camper prose (The Dyrt 2017 'riverside', 'lulled to sleep by the river') is vague and cannot be the basis. Default down to not waterfront (as State Line 4416 in p3-613). Lead: creekside if dated site photos show a pad at the water with an easy path down.

fees.note: $10 a site for up to 5 people; $20 (a 'double site') for more than 5. Pay on site (Recreation.gov Scan & Pay).

fees_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/rough-ridge-campground ('Single Site: $10 per night'; 'Double Site: $20 per night'; 'Fee is $10 per site for 5 people or less per site, and $20 per site for more than 5 people per site.'), read 2026-11-25; Scan & Pay from rec.gov 10158837 overview, read 2026-11-25

discounts_source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/recreation/rough-ridge-campground ('Discount Passes do not apply at Rough Ridge Campground.'), read 2026-11-25 - same as State Line 4416; contradicts the federal:usfs policy row and rec.gov's ScanPay site config (allowed_pass_types all true). Flagged.
flags: SEPARATE from 4416 State Line: its own FS page (FS point 35.2609,-84.0842 vs State Line's 35.2615,-84.0806), its own rec.gov facility (10158837 vs 10158872), and on Esri imagery (hw 300 m at 35.2612,-84.0824, rendered 2026-11-25) two distinct clearings on FR 210 ~300 m apart - Rough Ridge's pull-off and spurs at ~35.2610,-84.0840, State Line's at ~35.2617,-84.0809 (by 4416's pin). The FS page's 'one of two group campgrounds' is the pair Rough Ridge + State Line, which share the same site wording and fees.

Pin: FS page and rec.gov point 35.2609,-84.0842 sit on the west end (pull-off/tables); moved ~20 m E to 35.26095,-84.08400 to sit between the tables and the spurs. Elevation 781 m from 3DEP at the site flat.
'Group campground' wording: kept because single sites are sold FCFS at $10 for 5 or fewer, the same as State Line 4416 (kept); reviewer may judge otherwise.
Discount passes: FS says they do not apply here (same as 4416) - contradicts the federal:usfs policy row; discounts group returned as interagency_senior_access false to match 4416.

Site count not given: the FS page gives none; imagery shows two or three spurs plus a table pull-off; rec.gov carries one placeholder 'Standard' NONELECTRIC site plus three ScanPay management rows. sites.count omitted.
Hookups group omitted: primitive sites and no potable water, but no agency source states electric/water/sewer and the rec.gov catalog (1 placeholder site) is too small to read electric 0 from.

Campflare shows it 'closed' (as it does Holder Cove); FS page says 'Site Open' and FS alerts have no Tellico River Rd closure - likely Campflare reading rec.gov's FCFS no-inventory as closed. Kept open.

The Dyrt's single 2017 review mentions the 'Tanawaha Trail' and Rough Ridge summit, which are on the Blue Ridge Parkway in NC - the reviewer may have confused it with another Rough Ridge; not used for anything but the vague river line.
Google Maps (gm.py 2026-11-25): a results-page first hit 4.8 / 38 linking the old FS recid=35156 page, but its point 35.3186,-84.1253 is ~7 km NW - not confirmed as this campground; not used.

Phone is the Tellico Ranger District office from fs.usda.gov/r08/cherokee/offices (423-397-8455, as on Davis Branch 4418 / Birch Branch 15768); note Big Oak Cove 4417 stores the older 423-253-8400 listing number. rec.gov lists none.
No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Smokies 55 km) - irrelevant for a federal campground. RV Life rating not looked up (public campground).
